# First Grade

> Federal internships and entry-level jobs open now for students and recent grads, searchable by closing date, GS grade, state and agency, updated daily from USAJOBS data.

Guides are researched from official sources, cite them, and are reviewed regularly.

## Guides
- [Federal Resume vs Regular Resume: 7 Differences, 2-Page Rule](https://aobaworks.com/federal-entry-jobs/federal-resume-vs-regular-resume-7-differences-2-page-rule/): Federal resume vs regular resume: compare length, keyword matching, and duty rules side by side, plus USAJOBS Resume Builder steps for students.
